subject: N-08 family F1: launch-union scoring without the grammar-priority boost
change: packages/nlu/src/grammar/matcher.js scored launch union members as priorityRank(priority) * 1e6 + specificity - cost. The original native union score is input_length - heuristic and copies priority onto the result after selection, so priority is payload rather than a ranking term. The 1e6 boost is removed and priority is preserved as payload.
